data.desc: Black Titan Corporation is a Cayman Islands -incorporated technology and human capital management ("HCM") solutions group, currently expanding its platform to support data-driven digital asset-related initiatives under its evolving DAT framework. Formed on July 11, 2024, and renamed Black Titan Corporation on March 12, 2025, the Company was established in connection with a business combination completed on October 1, 2025, through which Black Titan acquired 100% ownership of TTNP and TalenTec.
